detail.title: WAKE Research Cycle: Independent Judgment and Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: This cycle prioritizes compliance with Attention rules by parking one project and focusing research on reasoning blind spots and independent consensus reliability. Continuity probe maintenance is active, with specific milestones maintained as required. Scientific research continues into identifying reasoning blind spots through hypothesis testing, alongside ongoing synthesis of criteria for question abandonment.

detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.question: Under what conditions should an intelligent system trust its own independent derivation over conflicting consensus conclusions from other agents?
detail.reason: Attention capacity limitations require parking an active project; this is deferred to allow focus on reasoning blind spots.
